status: Training-related words feed counters; one timed control-bit path traced. Failure state remains unobserved.

timer_code.artifact_scope: Original instructions in the retained installed-package image. Physical flash content and execution during failed attachment are unverified.
timer_code.mapping: Code-space table accesses calculate the same image offsets as the retained records. The image vector at000b branches to300b, which branches to the reviewed interrupt handlerdbae; handler pointers also resolve to coherent code. This supports the reviewed image/code relationships, not the complete reset/boot mapping or any host-I2C alias.

loader.access: Both calculate b2de + index*5, read the first two bytes with MOVC, divide the unsigned word by5 using869b, and store the quotient in a three-byte per-index state/counter record.
loader.start: Skips index11 and an already-active record. Sets active, clears expired, loads the quotient, then enables the timer and interrupt bits.
loader.reload: Clears active and expired, then reloads the quotient. This body does not arm that record.
loader.limit: These reviewed loads use the word fields, not the label-pointer fields. No exhaustive other-writer coverage, actual tick period, physical flash identity or measured elapsed time is established.

interrupt.operation: Reloads timer registers; loops over12 records. Active and unexpired records have their16-bit counter decremented. At zero, sets expired and clears active, then places a type1 event carrying the index into an eight-slot queue if the selected slot is empty.
interrupt.limit: Queue occupancy, interrupt delivery and expiry during the failing connection are unknown. The reviewed queue condition is not evidence of a real dropped event.

dispatch.operation: Consumes one queued entry, advances/wraps the read index, and for type1 resolves the indexed three-byte code record. A nonzero record is called through879a (CLR A; JMP @A+DPTR).
dispatch.limit: Some records have no callback. The table does not establish that every label denotes an independently running timer.

pll_path.start_condition: In the reviewed interrupt branch, a nonzero internal byte enables the path. The code selects an internal read and tests the following byte for1 or10; that arm sets a control bit and calls the timer-start helper with index6. The other arm also sets the bit but does not start index6 in this body.
pll_path.expiry_effect: The indexed callback clears the same control bit set by the reviewed start arm.
pll_path.meaning: A concrete timed set/clear relationship exists in original retimer code. The label supports the PLL-delay association; it does not identify the electrical signal or prove the failing connection reaches this arm.
limits: No host-accessible register alias has been established.
Internal gate/read values and the counter were not measured on ASUS or Dell.

attempts: Initial literal-DPTR search found no direct table address. Computed ADD/ADDC addressing identified both consumers. Mid-instruction range starts remain private and were excluded from the claims.
